findings.title: A recurring communal provision spans first and last
findings.claim: Within the declared 5:109-120 pericope, the requested table is framed as recurring communal provision whose temporal reach joins the first and the last members of the community.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun عِيدًا carries recurrence and contacts the explicit أَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا pair; the preceding eating request gives that recurrence a shared meal, while the focus sign and provision forms place the meal under a lasting public gift frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the table as provision meant to return with the community through time, rather than only as a one-time meal in a remembered scene.
findings.containment: The ordinary table, food, prayer, and first/last readings remain intact. The rain branch is activated only through the focus's sky contact, and no branch is expanded to every use of recurrence or provision.

epistemic.reason: The channel nomination and cited support are trusted, and all seven focus carriers and contacts are supplied exactly; qualified lexical identities remain bounded by their packet statements and boundaries.

findings.containment: This records the pericope's explicit condition and does not claim coercion, that every doubt is kufr, or that every punishment has this exceptional form. The disbelief and punishment branches retain only their supplied SOURCE_IMAGE facets.

findings.title: The table gathers swaying uncertainty into a center
findings.claim: The focus table's ordinary food-bearing sense can be held together with a material motion image: as a recurring communal center, it answers the preceding swaying uncertainty with a place where the group can settle.
findings.mechanism: The focus word مَائِدَة carries both the supplied motion/sway and food-bearing facets; these contact the preceding تَطْمَئِنَّ occurrence and the focus عيدًا, so the table's material center becomes an image for repeated communal settling.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the table as more than an object that satisfies hunger: it gathers a wavering group around a repeatable center without losing its literal food-bearing form.
findings.containment: This activates the motion and swaying facet as a branch-triggered material metaphor, exactly as qualified by the HFT record. It does not redefine مَائِدَة as social stabilization, and the reading remains exploratory and legacy_unbound.
